contexts.text: To cast out the man () = to utterly deprive of all will of good and understanding of truth, to such an extent that he is separated from them, and is not man.
To be cast out from upon the faces of the ground () = to be separated from all the truth of the Church.
Cast out this handmaid and her son () = that the things of the Rational which were merely human were to be extirpated. To cast out = to extirpate.
The interiors are full of anguish... wherefore they cast themselves out headlong...
That faith separated from charity now prevails is evident, for... he who believes differently from what dogma teaches is cast out from their communion...
They who put on another face are cast out from the Society.
They who correspond to the ejection of the urine...
The falsities with man are not cast out, but removed...
Like upheavings of a man's back...
He shall be accursed () = a casting out. To be accursed = to be cast out of the Church. Illustrated, Explained.
This is signified by the ejection from paradise.
With the Lord, there was not removal, but ejection of those things which he derived from the mother...
The ejection of all evils and falsities, Signified.
After death, the man himself also casts out (the Knowledges which do not agree with the love of his will). DLife 44.
Still, these evils cannot be so cast out that they may be said to be extirpated...
The Internal wills to cast out these delights...
How the Lord casts out the concupiscences of evil...
It is an error... that evils are separated from man; nay, cast out, when they are remitted...
The ejection from the garden = the deprivation of wisdom.
The court which is outside the temple cast out without (). To cast out without = to remove, here, from Heaven.
Cast him out... thus was I cast out.
When this was perceived, they were cast out of our land.
To cast out into the furthest corners () = to be deprived of all good and truth.
